question_cn: 2026 世界杯 B 组：波黑 vs 卡塔尔（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Bosnia-Herzegovina vs Qatar (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 174 分让波黑明显占优，但哲科伤情与末轮变数限制把握度，波黑胜率约 54%。
one_liner_en: A 174-point Elo gap makes Bosnia-Herzegovina the clear stronger side, but Dzeko's injury doubt and final-matchday variables cap conviction at about a 54% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差明显：波黑 1595（第 65）对卡塔尔 1421（第 96），Davidson 模型基准给波黑约 56% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: BIH 1595 (No. 65) vs Qatar 1421 (No. 96); the Davidson baseline gives BIH about a 56% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 波黑核心哲科肩伤后仅累计出场 64 分钟并缺席最后热身赛，锋线还有 Tabakovic、Sunjic 伤情，下调波黑 2pp。
key_reasons.en: BIH talisman Dzeko has only 64 minutes since his shoulder injury and missed the final warm-up, with Tabakovic and Sunjic also doubts — BIH shaded down 2pp.

key_reasons.cn: 卡塔尔在洛佩特吉手下仅 2 胜、自 2025 年 12 月后无正式比赛且热身负爱尔兰，低迷状态已反映在低 Elo 中。
key_reasons.en: Qatar have just 2 wins under Lopetegui, no competitive match since December 2025 and a friendly loss to Ireland; this poor form is already reflected in their low Elo.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net 2026-06-11 snapshot gives 55.8/23.7/20.5; bounded sourced adjustment of 2pp (BIH -2, Draw +1, Qatar +1) for BIH striker fitness doubts; no betting or prediction-market inputs used.
